actions.name: Philosopher?s Stone ? Attack
actions.description:
Magic action. One target: +8 to hit; 2d10 damage on a hit. Choose fire, cold, lightning, thunder, or radiant damage.

<avrae hidden>
_v: 2
name: Philosopher?s Stone ? Attack
activation_type: 1
automation:
  - type: condition
    condition: choice == "fire" or choice == "cold" or choice == "lightning" or choice == "thunder" or choice == "radiant"
    onTrue:
      - type: target
        target: each
        effects:
          - type: attack
            attackBonus: "8"
            hit:
              - type: damage
                damage: (2d10)[{choice}]
            miss: []
    onFalse:
      - type: text
        text: Choose fire, cold, lightning, thunder, or radiant damage.
    errorBehaviour: raise
</avrae>

actions.name: Philosopher?s Stone ? Area
actions.description:
Magic action. Each target makes a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d10 damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Choose fire, cold, lightning, thunder, or radiant damage.

<avrae hidden>
_v: 2
name: Philosopher?s Stone ? Area
activation_type: 1
automation:
  - type: condition
    condition: choice == "fire" or choice == "cold" or choice == "lightning" or choice == "thunder" or choice == "radiant"
    onTrue:
      - type: roll
        dice: (2d10)[{choice}]
        name: damage
        displayName: Damage
      - type: target
        target: each
        effects:
          - type: save
            stat: dex
            dc: "16"
            fail:
              - type: damage
                damage: "{damage}"
                fixedValue: true
            success:
              - type: damage
                damage: ({damage})/2
                fixedValue: true
    onFalse:
      - type: text
        text: Choose fire, cold, lightning, thunder, or radiant damage.
    errorBehaviour: raise
</avrae>

actions.name: Moon Earth
actions.description:
Moon Earth: Patchouli gains immunity to the next damage she receives.

<avrae hidden>
_v: 2
name: Moon Earth
activation_type: 1
automation:
  - type: target
    target: self
    effects:
      - type: ieffect2
        name: Moon Earth
        duration: -1
        stacking: false
        effects:
          immunities:
            - acid
            - bludgeoning
            - cold
            - fire
            - force
            - lightning
            - necrotic
            - piercing
            - poison
            - psychic
            - radiant
            - slashing
            - thunder
        desc: Immune to the next damage received. Remove immediately after that damage is blocked.
        buttons:
          - label: Remove after damage
            automation:
              - type: remove_ieffect
</avrae>

additionalAbilities.description:
When Patchouli uses her Magic Action she can combine two different elements to create a spell that alters her basic spell with a range of touch (you can touch an empty space in front of you) that deals 2d10 damage.
Fire - 120ft by 5ft in front of you.
Water - Heals allies instead
Wood - Doubles the damage roll
Metal - becomes a line 5ft by 25ft wide centered to the space she touches.
Earth - Ignores resistance

She can use the Water element equal to her Proficiency Bonus
additionalAbilities.name: Fire Water Wood Metal Earth Sign "Philosopher's Stone"

additionalAbilities.description:
Patchouli's damage spells can be changed to any of: Fire, Cold, Lightning, Thunder, or Radiant at will. 
Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn’t impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with spells.
additionalAbilities.name: Elemental Mastery

additionalAbilities.description:
Patchouli can further evolve one of the elements she used in her magic action by infusing it with sun or moon replacing the original effect of the selected element with a new effect. And only one infusion per turn.
She can use this ability equal to her Intelligence modifier.
Sun Infusion
Fire - becomes a line of 120ft by 5ft in which you control its path. Cannot hit the same target
Water - Heals allies instead and adds temporary hit points equal to the healed amount
Wood - Triples the damage roll
Metal - becomes a 15ft square radius centered to herself
Earth - Enemy becomes vulnerable to the attack

Moon Infusion
Fire - You teleport to a space you can see 60ft after casting a spell
Water - Reduce movement speed to 0 until the end of their turn and becomes prone for the whole duration.
Wood - Gain 2 levels of exhaustion
Metal - Becomes Stunned
Earth - You gain immunity to the next damage you receive
additionalAbilities.name: Sun Moon Sign "Royal Diamond Ring"

reactions.description:
If Patchouli gets hit with an elemental damage. She can use her reaction to absorb that element in the next spell she creates (Cannot absorb more than 1). She can use this reaction a number of times equal to her Proficiency Bonus
Fire - Adds Fire 
Cold - Adds Water
Radiant - Adds Wood
Lightning - Adds Metal
Thunder - Adds Earth
